2021: History Repeats
Post-2018 crash, altcoins were written off as too risky.
Then, DeFi, NFTs, and meme coins like $DOGE and $SHIB exploded. 🔥
Projects like $SOL and $ADA delivered massive returns, proving the doubters wrong.

Yes, history loves to repeat! 
Do you guys remember Dogecoin in January 2021?
